state:
Goal `core-request-2-2` is reached. Every `Core\Request` member owes nothing: each has
`about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and tests from Novis and from Rust.
`bun nv proofs --verify` is green over both halves of the class, and every bench was
re-measured against the current `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs`.

`nvs run --request` now matches the request against the program's own `#[Core\Route]`
table before the program starts, the way the server's door does. So
`Core\Request::route()` answers under `--request`, and a proof can show a real match.
`tests/conformance/core/a-program-run-with-a-request-is-matched-against-its-own-route-table.nvst`
pins it.

Any later change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs` makes every `Core\Request` bench
stale again, and the floor check fails until `bun nv proofs --record-perf` re-measures them.

items.text: **A route capture that is not UTF-8 names the member the program called** — the `RuntimeError` reads "the route capture `slug` percent-decodes …" and does not name `Core\Request::route()`, which `query()` and `post()` now do (`rule:statements/no-host-populated-variables`). The sentence is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:1335`. Optional polish, not owed by any check.
